subject: Request to move product walkthrough to match CTO landing + accommodate VP join
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acme-corp.com>, Samir Rao <samir@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move product walkthrough to match CTO landing + accommodate VP join

Hi Lina / Samir —

Quick note: Acme's CTO let us know they'll be landing later than expected (arrives around 12:30pm PT). Also heard the VP of Product may try to join late from a flight (possible +20 minute delay). Given both asks, can we shift the 11:30am walkthrough to a slot that gives a 10–15 minute buffer after the CTO lands so they can jump on without missing the kickoff?

Options that work on our side:
- 12:45pm–1:45pm PT (preferred — gives CTO time to land and settle)
- 1:15pm–2:15pm PT (if the VP needs a slightly later window)

We're happy to compress the agenda to a 45-minute focused demo if you'd prefer to keep it shorter and avoid a large shift. Attached is a trimmed agenda (Proposed_Agenda_v2.pdf) showing a compressed 45-minute flow.

If you confirm a time, I can update the invite and loop in our engineering lead for the deeper Q&A.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

attachments: Proposed_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page - compressed demo outline)

From: Lina Park <lina.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acme-corp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move product walkthrough to match CTO landing + accommodate VP join

Thanks, Vivek — and thanks for the agenda. Confirming CTO lands at 12:20pm PT and should be able to join by 12:45pm if traffic behaves. VP is on a red-eye and likely to be +15–30 mins late, but will try to hop on.

We'd prefer to keep the session to ~60 minutes so we can get to next meetings on time. 12:45pm–1:45pm PT works for us. Can you send an updated invite?

Also: can you ensure a 10-minute CTO-focused summary up front (high-level ROI / security commitments) so they don’t need to sit through every slide? Samir and I will flag any questions for the deeper Q&A.

—Lina
Lina Park
Director, Platform Procurement — Acme Corp
lina.park@acme-corp.com

Perfect — thanks for coordinating, Vivek and Lina. A couple internal asks from the delivery side:
- We'll re-sequence slides so the CTO summary (8 minutes) is front-loaded (value, compliance highlights, deployment options).
- Grace, can you prepare a 10-minute demo clip (pre-recorded) of the topology and latency numbers to play if the CTO joins late? That way we can jump to live instrumentation for anyone who stays.

If we compress to 60 minutes, proposed internal run order: 12:45–12:53 CTO summary (Vivek + Karthik)
12:53–1:10 focused demo (Grace)
1:10–1:30 Q&A (engineering deep-dive)

I can post a lightweight calendar note with the run order once Vivek confirms the final start time. Also putting the Cal poll link here for timezone sanity: https://cal.poll/3xQ9-demo-options

Karthik
Principal Solutions PM, Redwood
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
